items.html: And although they are seven kings, they are ten — after the manner of what we say, that there are seven Heichalot [halls] and yet they are but ten; for the first Heichal is comprised of the first three Sefirot and is called the Heichal of the Holy of Holies, and likewise the last Heichal is comprised of two: Yesod and Malchut, which is Livnat HaSapir [the sapphire brick]. So it is here, for they are ten Sefirot and are called seven kings.
